assumptions: Upright strips from one page; missing strips are not identified.

matching.method: full-height edge ink and text-row traces; shared FFT registration and constrained local alignment

verification.pair_score_fallback: Unchecked pairs are excluded from OCR ordering. Missing OCR evidence earns no text bonus. OCR-off mode uses all visual scores.
verification.ocr_sampling: Up to 24 text lines distributed over the full height, compacted without changing letter size.
verification.candidate_selection: Ten strongest successors and predecessors per strip, plus the complete visual path and selected alternatives.

refinement.stop_reason: No tested change improved the complete score.

document_contents: Text-bearing strips only. Low-ink strips stay in normalized_strips with unresolved positions.

preview.alignment: affine plus smooth local row offsets
